name: Placofin
look: a long bullet-headed prehistoric fish in pale blue armour plates, with brown dorsal spikes, a fan of brown tail fins and little pale legs underneath
entry: Its bullet-shaped head is armoured like a battering ram. It crept along ancient riverbeds on its little legs, and when it charged, the force of it could crack the stones of the riverbank.
how: Evolve Minnolith at level 38. It learns Head Smash when it evolves.
